channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: Layering and Cross-Cutting Bands
item.description: This mound exhibits layering and cross-cutting bands that correspond to an iron/magnesium phyllosilicate composition elsewhere in mounds in Chryse Planitia. This particular mesa has a large surface area and excellent exposure, which is ideal for observations of stratigraphic relationships. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
